properties.name: server.private-key
properties.description: Server's private key in JWK format. Should be provided via SERVER_PRIVATE_KEY_JSON environment variable in production.

properties.name: server.public-key
properties.description: Server's public key in JWK format. Should be provided via SERVER_PUBLIC_KEY_JSON environment variable in production.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-time-ms
properties.description: Expiration time for JWT tokens in milliseconds.

properties.name: spring.profiles.active
properties.description: Active Spring profile(s). Comma-separated in case of multiple profiles.
